Cosentino, sustainable materials brand, launches new collection
November 12, 2026 | 10:11 am CST
Cosentino, sustainable materials brand, launches new collection
Silestone Mineral Harmony is built to withstand the daily wear and tear across interiors with exceptional resistance to impacts, stains, moisture, scratching, and high temperatures

CORAL GABLES, Fla. — Cosentino, a global leader in the production and distribution of sustainable surfaces for architecture and design, announces the launch of Silestone Mineral Harmony, a zero crystalline silica* collection. Developed from recycled materials the collection introduces four all-new colors inspired by nature: Lightborne, Soft Sand, Silken Ash, and Clay Veil. Mineral Harmony extends Cosentino’s commitment to sustainable design and next-generation surface innovation to the Silestone portfolio.
“Today’s interiors are moving toward warmth, calm, and a closer connection to nature, and Mineral Harmony was designed with that shift in mind,” said Eduardo Cosentino, EVP Cosentino Group & CEO of Cosentino Americas. “The collection brings together recycled materials, a zero crystalline silica* composition, and the refined design that defines Silestone, showing that responsible innovation and beautiful surfaces go hand in hand.”

Silestone Mineral Harmony
Inspired by the quiet balance of mineral landscapes, Silestone Mineral Harmony translates the textures of nature into a refined interior surface. Deep veining and subtle mineral textures appear on serene understated backgrounds, creating a collection that feels grounded and serene while bringing warmth and depth to the spaces it defines.
Mineral Harmony is expressed through a palette of warm neutrals in four colorways, each evoking the tranquility of the natural world:
Lightborne: A luminous white with delicate veining and touches of gray add depth and warmth to any contemporary interior.
Soft Sand: A sandy tone with subtle patterning brings depth and movement without disrupting visual balance, making it a versatile and timeless option for all types of applications.
Silken Ash: A delicate and elegant ash gray that conveys a sense of calm and contemporary refinement, creating neutral, balanced atmospheres.
Clay Veil: A mineral-inspired clay beige that captures the warmth of earthy tones for projects seeking a serene and timeless aesthetic.

A New Generation of Zero Silica Surfaces
Beyond its tranquil, minimalist aesthetic, Mineral Harmony reflects Cosentino’s continued commitment to creating sustainable products. Mineral Harmony is the first collection from Silestone QXeron, a new generation of Silestone surfaces engineered to contain zero crystalline silica* while retaining the performance and design that defines Silestone. Utilizing Cosentino’s exclusive Hybriq+ technology, the collection incorporates a high percentage of recycled materials and premium minerals, uniting innovation, design and sustainability.
Lightborne and Silken Ash are available in a Polished finish in 2 and 3 cm thicknesses. Soft Sand is available in Polished and Suede finishes, and Clay Veil in Suede, both in 1.2, 2, and 3 cm thicknesses. With a full-body design that runs through the entire surface, Mineral Harmony is well suited for kitchen and bathroom countertops, islands, wall cladding, and furniture.
Silestone Mineral Harmony is the third product debut from Cosentino in 2026 and launches alongside Silestone Tajnar, a new colorway inspired by the enduring beauty of Taj Mahal quartz while maintaining all the performance qualities.
